closes_when: The grip triangle and its curl occupy the identical position and shape in all 16 frames, with the same left-edge crop as frame 1.
protect: The placement and angle of the shovel matching the film's shovel; the blade drawn as the doodle's open polygon with the broken collar line; the single thin straight shaft; the triangular grip with its curl at top; the stillness through the film's foot and hand entrance; the fixed grey scenery.
